subject: [PATCH 30/60] mm/memory_hotplug: keep private memory out of the auto-movable ratio

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a check to exclude private nodes and dynamic memory groups from the auto-movable ratio calculation. This is a good step towards addressing the issue of over-allocating ZONE_MOVABLE memory.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the auto-movable online policy in the Linux kernel by excluding private memory from the movable-to-kernel ratio calculation. The current implementation counts all populated zones, including private memory, which can lead to over-allocating ZONE_MOVABLE memory. This patch specifically addresses this issue by adding a check to exclude private nodes and dynamic memory groups from the statistics.
